set_text.text: Lead Managers, Acquisition Managers and anyone who takes seller calls.
Capture what was said on a call and keep the CRM record current without manual entry.
Logged call details, structured notes, the right fields filled, and an updated CRM record.
Follow-ups start from a clean record, and nobody spends the evening typing notes.
Writes into the CRM record that your pipelines and KPIs already use.
Sales managers and owners who coach Lead and Acquisition Managers.
Review calls consistently without listening to each one end to end.
Calls made by your Lead and Acquisition Managers.
A score for each call using 30+ dynamic scoring structures with tiered deductions, plus daily, weekly and monthly reports on strengths and weak spots.
Coaching time goes to the specific skill each person needs to work on.
Works on the same conversations AI Notes Taker captures.
New hires and experienced reps sharpening their skills.
Rehearse seller conversations and get feedback straight away.
Practice sessions across 10+ different scenarios each day.
Feedback on communication, objection handling and overall conversion skills.
Reps make their mistakes in practice, not on a live seller.
Complements the AI Sales Coach: one trains, the other reviews real calls.
Acquisition Managers and underwriters evaluating a property.
Build an underwriting analysis for a property from the information you have.
Multiple data sources, with a mode for however much data is available, plus property photos.
An analysis that reads condition from photos and lets you add or remove comps and notes, then rerun it at any time.
A consistent starting point for every deal, which you adjust with your own judgment.
Supports the offer decisions your Acquisitions pipeline tracks.
Lead Managers and marketers building or cleaning contact lists.
Find contact details for a property owner and screen existing contacts.
An address, an APN, or an address plus owner name.
Phone numbers and emails, and a DNC check of your existing contacts, from one dropdown in your CRM.
Contact discovery happens where the lead lives, not in a separate tool.
Runs from inside the CRM. DNC checking supports your process and is not a guarantee of compliant outreach.
Anyone working a lead that arrived with thin property data.
Fill in property information on a CRM record.
Available property data added to your CRM fields, with a view of exactly which fields changed.
Better-informed conversations and underwriting, with no guessing about what was updated.
Feeds the same CRM fields your team and the other tools read.
Owners and managers who run the business on its numbers.
See KPIs and accounting in one place.
Your CRM activity and accounting information.
Additional KPI visibility, plus a full accounting section.
Opportunities and inefficiencies show up earlier.
Builds on the KPI tracking in the CRM.
Owners, managers and operators who want answers without building a report.
Interact with your CRM and the whole Suite in conversation.
Answers drawn from your CRM and Suite, with supported actions taken and routines run for you.
Less clicking through screens to find or do something routine.
Talks with the CRM and the rest of the AI Suite.
Owners planning hiring, marketing spend and acquisitions.
Forecast where the business may be heading.
Your real KPIs, accounting and insights.
Planning starts from your own numbers. Projections are estimates, not guaranteed outcomes.
Uses what the AI Dashboard and AI Insights already know.
